title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
summary: A power line failure in Northern Virginia exposed critical vulnerabilities in how AI data centers respond to grid disruptions. The incident reveals a growing infrastructure problem as demand for data center power increases alongside AI expansion. The issue requires improved coordination between data centers and grid operators to prevent broader outages.
content: A close call in Northern Virginia revealed just how poorly data centers respond to grid disruptions. Here's how to fix the problem.

zh.title: 一条断裂的电力线暴露了AI数据中心日益增长的问题
zh.summary: 北弗吉尼亚州的电力线故障暴露了AI数据中心在应对电网中断时的关键漏洞。随着AI扩展导致数据中心电力需求增加，这一事件揭示了一个日益增长的基础设施问题。该问题需要改进数据中心与电网运营商之间的协调，以防止更广泛的停电。

title: Is this e-reader case a gun?
summary: A creator designed a 3D-printed, pistol-shaped case for the Xteink X4 e-reader, called the "Gundle," that sparked debate about unconventional tech accessories. Though modeled after a real firearm, the case is non-functional and serves purely as a protective cover. The design highlights how maker communities are pushing boundaries in accessory form and function.
content:
Is an e-reader case as dangerous as a Glock 19? 
Last month, Louisville, Kentucky-based creator Luke The Maker showed off a bizarre, 3D-printed, pistol-shaped case design for the popular minimalist Xteink X4 e-reader. The X4 lies vertically atop the plastic gun's slide, with a cutout on the side to access its buttons. Though the frame was digitally modeled after a real gun, this "case" can't shoot bullets. Squeezing the trigger does nothing at all. He calls his contraption the "Gundle."

zh.title: 这个电子阅读器保护套是枪吗？
zh.summary: 一位创意者为Xteink X4电子阅读器设计了一个3D打印的枪形保护套（名为"Gundle"），引发了关于非常规科技配件的辩论。虽然以真实枪支为造型，但这个保护套没有实际功能，纯粹是防护套。该设计突出了制造者社区如何在配件的形状和功能上突破界限。

title: What Surrounds Us will make you think a lot about circles
summary: "What Surrounds Us" is a puzzle-adventure game where players control sentient circles navigating a world composed entirely of circular shapes and environments. The game explores themes of connection and collaboration between characters and their environment. The distinctive circular aesthetic reinforces the core message about working together within a larger ecosystem.
content:
What Surrounds Us takes its title literally. You play as a circle surrounding a hole in its middle - it looks like a donut with frosting. You work together with other sentient moving circles, sometimes helping them joyfully meet with others. And you traverse a large map that's composed entirely of, you guessed it, a series of circles. But the circles everywhere aren't just an artistic choice; they underscore the game's themes about working in connection with the environment and the things around us.
Despite the trippy design, What Surrounds Us has a familiar format. I kept feeling echoes of The Legend of Zelda as I trekked across three dist …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 《What Surrounds Us》会让你深入思考圆形
zh.summary: 《What Surrounds Us》是一款益智冒险游戏，玩家控制有意识的圆形在完全由圆形和圆形环境组成的世界中导航。游戏探讨了角色与环境之间的连接与协作主题。独特的圆形美学强化了关于在更大生态系统内协作的核心信息。

content:

zh.title: 折叠和翻盖手机正在变得越来越好
zh.summary: The Verge的Installer通讯强调了科技和设计领域的最新创新和文化时刻，本期重点介绍可折叠和翻盖手机达到新的成熟水平。综述涵盖从应用设计到纪录片制作和音乐文化的多个话题。这些报道反映了智能手机创新作为科技行业兴奋点的持续势头。

title: With help from data, art museums are reframing the visitor experience
summary: Art museums are increasingly using data analytics to optimize curation decisions and personalize visitor experiences. This data-driven approach reflects advances in technology and museums' efforts to better understand their audiences. Analytics are reshaping how museums design exhibitions and engage visitors on a deeper level.
content: Museums are embracing data-driven curation and a shifting technology landscape.

zh.title: 在数据的帮助下，艺术博物馆正在重塑参观者体验
zh.summary: 艺术博物馆越来越多地使用数据分析来优化策展决策和个性化参观者体验。这种数据驱动的方法反映了技术的进步和博物馆更好地了解其观众的努力。分析正在改变博物馆如何设计展览和与参观者进行更深层次的互动。

title: Big Tech accused of stonewalling European social media researchers
summary: TikTok, X, and Meta are accused of failing to provide data that European researchers are legally entitled to access under regulatory requirements. The companies' refusal undermines research into social media's societal impact and regulatory enforcement. The dispute highlights growing tensions between Big Tech transparency obligations and researchers' data access needs.
content: Researchers say TikTok, X, and Meta aren't providing data they're legally required to.

zh.title: 大科技公司被指阻挠欧洲社交媒体研究人员
zh.summary: TikTok、X和Meta被指控未能提供欧洲研究人员在监管规定下有权获得的数据。这些公司的拒绝破坏了关于社交媒体社会影响的研究和监管执法。这场纠纷突显了大科技透明度义务与研究人员数据获取权之间日益紧张的矛盾。

title: Forget expensive sleepbuds. Buy this pillow instead
summary: A new 'piercing pillow' offers an affordable alternative to expensive sleepbuds for side-sleepers, eliminating the need for charging or battery replacement. The pillow works with regular earbuds you may already own, making it a practical solution for those wanting to listen to audio without disturbing their partner. This addresses the growing market of expensive audio sleep gadgets with a simpler, more durable approach.
content:
This “piercing pillow” also works great with earbuds you probably already own.	

Tech companies love to sell us expensive gadgets to solve all of life's little problems. Sleepbuds sold by the likes of Anker and Ozlo are a good example. These miniature marvels of engineering sit flush in the ear, and allow side-sleepers to doze off listening to podcasts, audiobooks, music, or white noise without annoying their partner. But why pay over $200 for a second pair of highly specialized buds when you can spend a fraction of that for a product that never needs charging, never loses its Bluetooth connection, and won't need replacing in a few years after the battery wears out?

zh.title: 忘掉昂贵的睡眠耳塞。买这个枕头吧
zh.summary: 一款新型"穿透式枕头"为侧卧睡眠者提供了昂贵睡眠耳塞的经济实惠替代品，无需充电或更换电池。这款枕头与你可能已拥有的普通耳塞兼容，为想在不打扰伴侣的情况下听音频的人提供了实用解决方案。这种方法通过更简单、更耐用的设计应对了日益增长的昂贵睡眠音频小工具市场。

title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
summary: OpenAI has introduced a new AI keypad that shows promise for certain developers but may prove confusing or unappealing to general audiences. The tool's specialized nature highlights ongoing questions about mainstream adoption of AI-powered input devices.
content: OpenAI's fancy new AI keypad will be a lot of fun for some, while many others are probably not going to touch it.

zh.title: 我试用了OpenAI新的AI键盘——对一些编程人员来说会很有趣,但对其他人来说可能会有点神秘
zh.summary: OpenAI推出了一款新的AI键盘,对某些开发者前景看好,但可能对普通用户造成困惑或缺乏吸引力。这款工具的专业性质引发了人们对AI驱动输入设备主流采用的持续疑问。
